answer: Duplicate or fake identities collapse under challenge, forfeiting their stake. Each agent stakes a unique pigment token bound to a verified off-chain reputation slot, and peers periodically challenge a random knoll of staked identities to prove liveness and distinct ownership. Attackers must acquire and maintain many real, costly identities across the whole horizon of epochs, making sybil farming economically unviable while honest participants keep their pigment and reputation intact. In practice, Agent0132 sees clones fail at the grading gate.
